Declared HS 220299 matches the observed customs HS 22029990 (8-digit extension of 220299) — no HS correction needed.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: 4 customs rows dated 2026-02-27, all Chennai Sea -> Colombo (Sri Lanka), buyer/counterparty JJ LARISH MARKETING PVT LTD (Colombo, Sri Lanka), HS 22029990, BOLs 1081001 and 1079351 (two BOL numbers across four rows, i.e. two BOLs x two line items). Source counter (4) equals rows actually seen (4) — no discrepancy. Products: almond milk and oats milk, 1 L boxes, 12 pcs/box, batch nos GWL-86 and GWALD-41.
